title: Feedback On Browser MMORPG
author: codimastudios
selftext:
Hi All!

I've been really into persistent worlds for a while but never had the means to make my own until now.

Through working with Claude and Codex, I really feel like I've made a pretty cool little online world.

However, even with only using human made art, the UI itself still seems to have an "AI Made" feel to it.

Does anyone happen to have any suggestions as to how I could improve the look to make it look less cold and made by AI?

Please feel free to check it out at: [https://codiquest.online/](https://codiquest.online/)

replies.author: codimastudios
replies.body: Fair, I get what you mean, I should probably get some more art in place

replies.author: Square_Reason_6490
replies.body: I wouldn’t react to that comment, a dry ui can work just look at last of us, you need more feedback than that to react to why does it need more? Should those bounding boxes look like they are made of paper or some kind of metal? Why are you doing that? Who do you want the player to feel like they are? Some may not like your choices but if you have solid rules as to why it will help you pick what feedback you should react to

replies.author: codimastudios
replies.body: I appreciate the advice, I guess my main thing is I do want people to feel immersed, but I also want to keep it really easy to understand and figure out where you want to go. So I've been trying to find the balance.

replies.author: Square_Reason_6490
replies.body: In my opinion there is no balance only your direction and rule set, if you stick with that your game will be consistent. I haven’t clicked the link to actually play but looking at the screen shot someone shared it looks more like a website than a game at the moment starting with what your art direction is will do tons of heavy lifting for you

replies.author: codimastudios
replies.body: It is a menu based game for sure but the screenshot sent above is an AI generated image based on the look of my game I guess haha

replies.author: Square_Reason_6490
replies.body: Ahhh I see, you need a bit of a teaser of the game, looks like a ton to commit to before you have any idea what the game is, and the game maybe broken because there is a broken looking pink humanoid model or maybe it’s a scary and that’s why it looks broken it’s a lot to take in

replies.author: codimastudios
replies.body: Thank you for that, the pink guy is mid animation but I agree, does look broken lol. I'll see what changes I can make!

replies.author: Ok-Investment4414
replies.body:
the txt game side u got locked i guess. but the imagery lacking it felt like amazon or fb alot a menus . and the combat -\_- u can use threes js or svg to get some animation.Idk your audience but that nostalgic menu gotta go if its people under 30 (its the default for text games that  craigslist look). You already using ai just hammer out some mobs , weapons , areas etc a single prompt can get u about 9 decent hq images.   
  
Mobile games like this shows the cities and travel you can do a similar thing so its not just menu-no-jutsu 

Claude design can hammer out the ui , you can also search for places like behance and dribble . I also never got the 2d , pixelated , 2.5/3d graphic combination.

replies.author: connected_user93
replies.body: what makes you think it is uninspired?

comments.author: connected_user93
comments.body: I feel like a lot of people in this sub are not going to be familiar with the concept of a "text based roleplaying game" / graphical MUD so prepare for a lot of people complaining that there are too many menus, etc.

replies.author: codimastudios
replies.body: That's true haha, its a little niche for sure! Just hoping to make it look as "legit" as I can.

replies.body: :-/ we are bro some ppl like dnd and others like to have a controller + screen . with the barrier to entry being negative u gotta stand out because everyone is doing the bare minimum
